title: ShopRecord
description: Producer: osm_ingest.py. Consumer: SQLite DB. additionalProperties:false is the hallucination gate. One real shop sourced from OpenStreetMap. Identity fields are never AI-generated; osm_ingest.py validates every row against this before upsert.

categories.description: Every internal category the shop's OSM tags map to, per data/category_tag_map.json. First entry is primary.

address.description: Joined from OSM addr:* tags when present; null when OSM has none. Never synthesized.
